integrity: The subgroup lattice is derived independently from the p-torsion plane, the cyclic order-p^2 subgroup count, and their intersections. The forcing criterion is proved in both directions and is checked by exhaustive enumeration for four primes. The withdrawn 2013 preprint is used only for dated definition/classification metadata; no substantive premise relies on its withdrawn theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the subgroup intersection graph of C_{p^2} times C_p.
The scalar zero forcing number and field-independent minimum rank are prior coverage for the underlying pineapple graph.
The originality claim is the complete zero forcing set classification and polynomial together with the subgroup-lattice realization.
A differently named graph-family source could in principle contain the same pineapple polynomial.
title: Zero forcing polynomial of the subgroup-intersection pineapple for \(C_{p^2}\times C_p\)
